findings.summary: D5 parks an agy key on a stated or guessed reset when the /quota probe cannot check it
findings.reason: The plan is frozen for this change; D5's fallback is deliberate.

findings.summary: Deviation 2 splits QuotaCooldowns as a partial class, against coding-style
findings.reason: Rejected for the plan (frozen) but a real defect in the code, fixed there by merging into one file.

findings.summary: A spent agy refusal without an AGY_ERROR line (stdout only) is never Spent
findings.reason: The plan is frozen; D2 reads the AGY_ERROR line only, on purpose.

findings.summary: agy /quota probe credential errors are swallowed into CannotCheck
findings.reason: The plan is frozen; agy credential diagnosis is another feature.

findings.summary: malformed cooldown file treated as empty then overwritten (architecture)
findings.reason: Plan §8/S19: a torn file is no cooldown and is overwritten by the next park; a failed READ (IO error) is refused, not overwritten.

findings.summary: malformed cooldown file overwritten without warning (reliability)
findings.reason: Same as above; one warning is logged.

findings.summary: store accepts arbitrary keys and reset values; unbounded growth
findings.reason: Keys come from a closed table, expired entries are dropped on every write, S20 pins 16 KiB; validating callers is outside the plan.

findings.summary: /quota probe reuses the refused launch's environment incl. credential
findings.reason: By design (D6): the owner's own command with the same binary, environment and directory; agy reads its sign-in from there.

findings.summary: PlanAsync picks the first refusal / lifts on a sibling Ok
findings.reason: Designed: a spent refusal wins over an answer; an answered launch with an available gauge lifts (D4).

findings.summary: expired gauge reset is turned into a guess
findings.reason: Plan S9-S14: a past instant is no reset, never a park on the past; a marked guess is the plan's answer.
Wrong: CoolingReasonOf already yields to AuthFor(...) == unavailable.
Wrong: lock and file are separate; a re-park carries a new SinceUtc so it is a real write; the absent-key lift compares equal in live order.

findings.summary: EntryOf recomputes Consecutive against filtered live entries
findings.reason: Designed (S35): the count is read from the LIVE list inside the lock; doubling restarts after a gap.

findings.summary: LeftOf can print a negative time
findings.reason: Not reachable: the entry was just returned by Standing; worst case 'in 0 min'.
stderr is bounded and has one or two AGY_ERROR lines; no measured cost.

findings.summary: RateLimited fails on JSON with trailing non-JSON
findings.reason: Outside the plan; unchanged text fallback is documented.

findings.summary: round blocks on sequential /quota probes, no progress notice
findings.reason: Plan §8: one child per spent key, 30 s bound, at most three keys; progress/concurrency not asked for.

findings.summary: Standing re-reads the file on every call; no cache
findings.reason: By design (D4, §8): other processes' parks must be seen on the next decision.

findings.summary: RateLimited parses JSON before checking the exit code
findings.reason: No behaviour change; micro-optimisation outside the plan.
